references.text: Dan is mentioned as one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of Dan during the census.
The tribe of Dan is mentioned in connection with the camp arrangement, where they had their place on the north side of the tabernacle.
Bukki son of Jogli was appointed as the leader of the tribe of Dan during the distribution of the land of Canaan.
Dan was born as a son of Jacob through Bilha, Rachel's servant woman, and became the ancestor of the tribe of Dan.
